name: Enforces Policy
description: A Duo application enforces a custom policy — for all its users (apply_type app) or for the members of specific groups (apply_type group_app, a group policy). An application with no app-level edge inherits the account's Global Policy; inheritance is derived, never stored as an edge.

apply_type.description: Where the policy is attached (Duo's policy_applies_to.apply_type): `app` — every user of the application; `group_app` — a group policy, effective only for members of `group_names` in this application.

group_names.description: For a group policy: the groups it targets in this application, by name. Absent for apply_type app.

group_position.description: For a group policy: its position in the application's group-policy stack (Duo's group_position). Order decides which group policy wins for a user in several groups.
